text: It feels exhilarating and slightly disorienting to be here. The stark glass walls and visible timer beyond the entrance set a tone of anticipation. Upon entering, the vibrant interactive wall, full of text and technology, makes me consider the role of research and development in shaping our collective future. I’m intrigued by the intentional design, and a bit dwarfed by the scale and ambition of these efforts—the atmosphere hints at both innovation and uncertainty.
